script_text: Aquarius vs Capricorn — Saturn is conjunct your partnership axis, and the stars are watching. Air and Earth clash between you, creating tension that's frustrating yet magnetic. Aquarius floats free while Capricorn demands structure, and that contrast fuels this bond. Aquarius Venus craves emotional freedom and unconventional approaches to love. Capricorn Mars demands total loyalty, which can feel like a cage to your independent spirit. Mercury creates a square between your styles, sparking constant communication friction. Aquarian detachment meets Capricorn's need to control every conversation, leaving feelings unspoken. Saturn transiting your 7th House is forcing a harsh love confrontation right now. A 10th House career conjunction is activating your shared ambitions, and aligning on goals is mandatory or resentment builds. The one thing that makes or breaks this couple is embracing each other's differences, because Saturn doesn't reward those who resist change. Comment your partner's sign!
